purpose: Teach: 思想家/松山/結城/侍/みえる/回戦/移さ/舞台裏

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、近代の、本気で、絶対、思想家、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, you really handled modern philosophical thinkers in your paper. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Steady eye contact. Measured pace with a slight lift on 「感心」 — genuine admiration, not performative. Teacher-to-student but respectful of the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本気で、絶対、松山、絶対、の文学、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I focused on Matsuyama's literary work in particular — it required really deep research, and I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful formality with quiet pride underneath. Direct gaze back. Clear articulation. A slight breath before 「感謝」 — sincere gratitude, not just polite language.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、結城、絶対、紬の、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you wove in the tradition of Yuki-tsumugi — that was thoughtful. Really well integrated.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself but sharing the thought. Slight pause before naming the textile tradition — savoring the specificity. Warm but observational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。中世の、本気で、絶対、侍、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I made sure to include medieval samurai culture as a through-line. The research was extensive, and I really do appreciate your guidance.
lines.style: Steady confidence. The slight formal register holds, but there's ease in it now. Not reciting — explaining something she's genuinely thought about. Small nod as she speaks.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 未来図に、本気で、絶対、みえる、絶対、社会像、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you projected that into the future — the kind of society you envisioned — that was the strongest part. You made it live.
lines.style: Engaged and present. Leans in slightly. The praise is specific and unguarded. A little wonder in the delivery, like she's seeing something Sakura created for the first time.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。第一、本気で、絶対、回戦、絶対、の、絶対、データ、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I gathered a lot of data from the first round of interviews and tried to make it concrete. I couldn't have done it without your input.
lines.style: Genuine, grounded. The formality stays, but warmth creeps in. Not deflecting — accepting the compliment while acknowledging support. Voice settles lower, more natural.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化財、本気で、絶対、移さ、絶対、れた、絶対、博物館、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even the cultural artifacts you discussed — how they were preserved in the museum collection — you brought real specificity to that section.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational now. Slower pace. A small smile in the voice. She's no longer evaluating — she's appreciating the work as a whole, as a peer would.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。劇場の、本気で、絶対、舞台裏、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes, the theater backstage section was important to me. I wanted to show how craft lives in those unseen spaces. Thank you for believing in the vision.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The formal register drops just slightly — more herself now, less student. Steady and sincere. The final words land softly, as if the conversation has moved into genuine connection.
